Follow-up from #35922 (PR #36415, checklist items for the list column-header menu). L1 found the gap; filed by the seat. Parent: #35922.

## What happens

The record page's related list also opens the column-header menu (`headerMenu: true` in plugin-detail `RelatedList.tsx`). No platform checklist item drives the menu on that host, so a break there is caught by nobody.

## To do

1. Add checklist items for the related-list host: sort, hide a column, and the draft Save or Discard, mirroring the list items #36415 adds.
2. Note any action the related-list host leaves out on purpose.

## Acceptance

- A checklist run on a record page with a related list exercises the header menu and records each step.

p3 · area:ux · domain:ui. Test coverage gap.
